verdict.comment: There is a compelling list of positives as regards HANDSTANDS, who is first choice ahead of Caldwell Potter and Stellar Story.

comments.caldwellpotter: Excellent front-running performance at the Cheltenham Festival; commands respect
comments.dancingcity: Grade 1 novice winner over hurdles on this card last year; retains potential over fences
comments.dontrightlyknow: Low-mileage 10yo who is still unbeaten over fences; rising force for Polly Gundry
comments.handstands: Game performance in Grade 1 Scilly Isles at Sandown; progressive and top on the figures
comments.jordans: Faces a difficult task at this level and has stamina to prove over the new trip
comments.quaidebourbon: Unseated rider in the Brown Advisory but this 6yo remains a promising sort
comments.stellarstory: Good second in the Brown Advisory; threatening to land a Grade 1 prize over fences
comments.thechangingman: Consistent this term; second in a Cheltenham Festival handicap over 3m1f last time

races.raceComment: caldwellpotter is marginally preferred with a score of 62.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more reliable profile over dancingcity. Won 2 of last 4 starts. Excellent course form of 5/11 at aintree. Key attributes include positive comments.

verdict.comment: Back down slightly in distance and returned to a sharper course, BE AWARE (nap) is worth another chance. Wade Out is second choice.

comments.beaware: Outstayed over a stiff 2m5f when 3-1 favourite for the Coral Cup; remains of interest
comments.beaconedge: Ran respectably in the Coral Cup but this 11yo looks set for another supporting role
comments.blenkinsop: Signs of retaining ability last time but faces a stiffer task in this field
comments.brentfordhope: Drops back in class but has stamina to prove over this new trip
comments.favourandfortune: Landed the Scottish Champion Hurdle last April and this may be the time to catch him
comments.gincoco: Along with several other runners he goes into unknown territory over 2m4f
comments.hansard: Inconsistent this season; something to prove upped in distance
comments.helnwein: Unsuccessful over fences this term; notable win at Sandown (2m) on last hurdles start
comments.ikesport: Has lost his consistency; addition of hood needs to make a difference
comments.imposetoi: Progressive; ran well in first-time cheekpieces in the Coral Cup most recently; solid
comments.kopeckdemee: Progressive in France; well beaten on debut for Willie Mullins but should do better
comments.listentoyourheart: Consistent mare who is 3-5 over hurdles; has Grade 2 form; solid contender
comments.minellamissile: Grade 2 winner last term; hard to fancy on this season's form
comments.offthejury: Still a maiden under rules but went close in notable 2m4f race at Sandown most recently
comments.seriousoperator: Absent since coming up well short (off 1lb higher) in this race 12 months ago
comments.steelally: Raised only 2lb for a good effort in Fontwell Grade 2 and remains unexposed beyond 2m
comments.tintintin: Has made the frame in a few major handicaps at about 2m; each-way possibilities
comments.tuneinabox: Below par last time but largely consistent otherwise; wears first-time cheekpieces
comments.wadeout: Ready success last time took his overall record to 5-7; open to further progress
comments.wellingtonarch: Latest effort took his hurdles record to 21212; may do better still; not ruled out
comments.westernwalk: 2m6f/3m winner who is likely to find this sharp 2m4f inadequate
comments.wrecklesseric: Unlucky second in the Imperial Cup; likely player provided he stays this new trip

races.raceComment: imposetoi is marginally preferred with a score of 58.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over helnwein. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 6/11 at aintree. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

verdict.comment: The oldest horses in the field have plenty going for them. ELDORADO ALLEN is the pick ahead of Latenightpass then Escaria Ten.

comments.adamantlychosen: One of five for Willie Mullins; he's struggled to get competitive this season
comments.amirite: Not at his best on his last few starts but on a handy mark and could bounce back
comments.ashtreemeadow: Back from a break with a return to form needed but he could prove well suited to this test
comments.bad: Things have clicked in these blinkers; clear with course specialist at Kempton latest
comments.bluelord: 10yo; not the force of old but took step back in right direction last time; not ruled out
comments.drealdeal: Two wins last spring but this 10yo is probably vulnerable in this hot handicap
comments.eldoradoallen: 11yo who is on a long losing spell but he ran well for a long way in last year's National
comments.escariaten: Promising run in Cheltenham Cross Country; could have a part to play now back down in trip
comments.excello: Ran well over 3m at Sandown last time and could benefit from the drop back in trip; chance
comments.fantasticlady: Pulled up at Cheltenham Festival but the return to these fences could reignite some spark
comments.frenchdynamite: Ran well for fair way before fading in Cheltenham Cross Country but others appeal more
comments.galaw: Return to form needed but he's 3lb lower than when 2nd in Paddy Power Gold Cup in November
comments.gemirande: 2 wins towards end of last year but 3 lesser runs have followed; has to get back on track
comments.gentlemandemee: Last season's Champion Chase runner-up but he hasn't been at his best this term
comments.ginnysdestiny: Runner-up in two 2m4f Grade 1s last spring but somewhat underwhelming this season
comments.glengouly: Runner-up in two major Irish handicaps last winter but not in the same form this term
comments.grandeurdame: 9yo who has been better than ever this season; failed to stay 3m1f in the Ultima
comments.jamesduberlais: Not easy to win with but he's just 1lb higher than when second in this last year
comments.jetoile: Well treated on form as recent as last May but this 10yo has struggled in the main since
comments.latenightpass: Likes these fences; ran well in Cheltenham Cross Country last time; firmly in calculations
comments.lisnamultlad: Now just 1lb higher than when making all at Cheltenham in October; could make a bold bid
comments.loungelizard: Won at Huntingdon latest; needs career best today but he's shown promise over these fences
comments.marblesands: Solid form in the main during this second season over fences & he's an each-way contender
comments.marsharper: Modest strike-rate and on long losing run, but ran well at Cheltenham Festival last month
comments.minelladrama: Out of form elsewhere the last twice but has a good record here over regular obstacles
comments.shantreusse: Made very bad mistake when 7th in this last year; could be involved if handling conditions
comments.soulicon: Won good-quality, seven-runner handicap at Kempton in December and is just 2lb higher here
comments.thegoffer: Encouraging fourth in the Cross Country at Cheltenham and he's not ruled out
comments.thekingofprs: Stamina to prove and below par in the Grand Annual, but progressive in Ireland previously
comments.westernzephyr: In good heart in the autumn but well beaten the last twice and unproven at the trip

races.raceComment: loungelizard is marginally preferred with a score of 65.3%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over jetoile. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 4 wins from 17 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

verdict.comment: Dylan Johnston rides CELTIC DINO instead of the same connections' classy operator Lump Sum and his mount is of strong interest.

comments.afadil: Third in this last year when 6lb higher; very nearly won the Imperial Cup last time
comments.alnilam: 2nd in the Morebattle and 2lb lower here if taking into account Beau Morgan's allowance
comments.celticdino: He's a good jumper who could have a big role to play off this mark in his first handicap
comments.cormier: Limited appeal on what he's shown in two handicaps following a long absence
comments.countrypark: Made a respectable handicap debut at Ascot and dropping back to 2m could benefit him
comments.diamondsforluck: Unexposed handicap debutant who arrives here after three no-nonsense novice wins
comments.dominicsfault: Retains potential but has something to prove under these ground conditions
comments.fiercelyproud: Career-best form in his Ascot win and there were valid excuses last time at Newbury
comments.grimaud: Recent maiden winner and he's an unexposed handicap debutant for a top yard
comments.hamsiyann: May yet have more to offer as a hurdler but this drop back to a sharp 2m is worrying
comments.jackhyde: Another improving novice, who hasn't been overly stretched to win minor races at Southwell
comments.kingshill: Will need to run a lot better than in his last three handicaps; opposable
comments.lario: 0-6 for current yard and doesn't look on an overly generous mark; cheekpieces first time
comments.lumpsum: Disappointed last time and regular partner Dylan Johnston rides stablemate Celtic Dino
comments.luttrelllad: Ran well in this last year and he's back after a return to winning ways at Taunton
comments.manuelito: Noticeably strong in the market when making all for a 2l success at Newbury; up 4lb
comments.moonchime: Up 11lb for his Stratford win but that was only his second run back from wind surgery
comments.oldgregorian: Solid third in the Morebattle but again he may have no more than place aspirations
comments.shesasaint: Classy mare, still lightly raced; able when fresh and could have been saved for this
comments.slugger: 3-4 for this yard but limitations were seemingly exposed in the Morebattle at Kelso
comments.tapley: 66-1 when well held in the Imperial Cup last time and he is again up against it
comments.washington: 2-3 for Harry Derham and reasonable to put a line though his latest Newbury effort
